mapper.sql: M.MENU_ID AS menuId, M.MENU_NM AS menuNm, M.MENU_URL AS menuUrl, M.MENU_KEY AS menuKey, M.MENU_TYPE AS menuType, M.UPPER_ID AS upperId, M.SORT_ORDR AS sortOrdr, M.USE_AT AS useAt
mapper.select: SELECT , P.MENU_NM AS upperNm FROM OPS_MENU M LEFT JOIN OPS_MENU P ON P.MENU_ID = M.UPPER_ID ORDER BY M.SORT_ORDR, M.MENU_ID
SELECT FROM OPS_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_TYPE = 'GROUP' ORDER BY M.SORT_ORDR, M.MENU_ID
SELECT FROM OPS_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_ID = #{menuId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(MENU_ID), 0) + 1 FROM OPS_MENU
INSERT INTO OPS_MENU (MENU_ID, MENU_NM, MENU_URL, MENU_KEY, MENU_TYPE, UPPER_ID, SORT_ORDR, USE_AT) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{menuNm}, #{menuUrl}, #{menuKey}, #{menuType}, #{upperId}, #{sortOrdr}, #{useAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM OPS_MENU M WHERE M.USE_AT = 'Y' AND ( M.MENU_TYPE = 'GROUP' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OPS_MENU_AUTH A WHERE A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND A.ROLE_ID = #{role}) ) ORDER BY M.SORT_ORDR, M.MENU_ID
SELECT MENU_ID FROM OPS_MENU_AUTH WHERE ROLE_ID = #{role}
